servers.title: Servers
servers.description: Read-only inventory collected over pinned SSH connections.
servers.emptyBody: Pair a Linux host to review its services, packages, and deployment identity.
servers.verifyFingerprint: I independently checked this fingerprint with the server administrator.
servers.fingerprintWarning: A host-key change must be reviewed. Do not accept a new fingerprint automatically.
servers.installInstructions: Install this line at /var/lib/secmon/.ssh/authorized_keys using the documented permissions. Keep the private key in the operating-system credential store.
servers.manualInstall: After installing the key on the server, approve one inventory transfer.
servers.transferWarning: The inventory contains package and service metadata. It remains on this device and is saved with the approval time.
servers.approveTransfer: I reviewed the inventory transfer and approve sending it to this device.
servers.pairDescription: The desktop checks the SSH host key, pins the confirmed fingerprint, and stores a dedicated key in the operating-system credential store.
servers.noHosts: No supported hosts found. SSH key files were not read.
servers.unreachable: Server is offline or could not be reached

ai.mcpSourceAccessHelp: Granting a project lets the configured local MCP client read its redacted source files; that client may forward returned text. Approve only projects suitable for that client. Access is off by default, and every grant or revocation is recorded in Activity.
ai.selectProject: Select a project from the sidebar before using AI.
ai.approvalHelp: Only the redacted prompt and data categories shown here may be sent. Project permissions and the budget are checked again before sending.

onboarding.title: Set up Security Monitor
onboarding.description: Choose your privacy and appearance preferences before adding local projects.
onboarding.privacyTitle: Your data stays local by default
onboarding.privacyBody: Project paths, source code, lockfiles, and inventory stay on this device. Public advisory downloads are optional. Server inventory is transferred only after a separate approval.
onboarding.scannerBody: Installed scanner tools can be used for full scans. Missing tools stay unavailable until you approve a verified installation.
onboarding.advisoryBody: Allow public advisory data downloads now? No project file or local inventory is sent.
onboarding.projectBody: Select a local folder. You can scan it now or add it without scanning.
onboarding.serverBody: Pair a Linux host now or continue without a server.
onboarding.aiBody: AI setup can be completed later after you choose a provider and approve its data access.
onboarding.privacyDetailsBody: Project files and inventory are read locally. Only explicitly approved advisory downloads, scanner downloads, and SSH inventory collection can use a network connection.
